# Figma skill placeholders

Each directory keeps the name of a skill from Figma's `mcp-server-guide` (revision in [../skills-source.json](../skills-source.json)), but its `SKILL.md` is a placeholder written for this test. The upstream skill materials are governed by the Figma Developer Terms, not OpenCode's MIT license, so they are not redistributed. The test only proves that the unmodified upstream `index.ts` registers one skill per listed name.
